line: Learn and use the name of someone you usually overlook.
paragraph: The owners of an auto-repair shop in Texas used to refurbish one donated car each year for a neighbor in need. Now, they and other donors help them provide multiple vehicles every year. They hand the keys to community members who need reliable transportation. This project is called Autos for Love. The shop owners find delight in giving these cars away.

seed.summary: Once a year, the owners of a Texas auto-repair shop would refurbish a donated car and then hand the keys to a member of their community in need.
